newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Sievert says mark appreciation corrected.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Sievert says mark appreciation corrected.

text.p: The excessive appreciation in the German mark seen in 1995 has corrected, Bundesbank council member Olaf Sievert said on Tuesday.

In a speech prepared for delivery at a reception in Leipzig, Sievert said, "The appreciation of the mark seen in spring 1995, which was absolutely unfitting for the real economy, has in the meantime been corrected."
He said that the real external value of the mark compared with 18 major currencies was now at the level seen in mid-1994, adding "which does not mean that this is a low level".
Sievert is head of the regional central bank located in Leipzig. A text of his speech was released by the regional bank in advance of delivery.
